component.name: CreatorCanvas
component.summary: A simple yet powerful image editor for content creators

description.p: CreatorCanvas is a lightweight desktop image editor that focuses on what content creators actually need: fast canvas sizing for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, real layer control without bloat, and reliable export in PNG/JPEG/WebP.
Features include: visual template picker, drag-and-drop image import, vector shapes, editable text, undo/redo, autosave with session recovery, and a clean dark UI.

release.description: Phase 2 release: AI background removal, raster tools (Crop, Scissors, Wand, Clone Stamp), Paint & Flood Fill brushes, text gradients, 3D tilt perspective, and color adjustments.
Initial release. Layers, image import, text, shapes, presets, undo/redo, export.
